bio.text: Brad Meyer won the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026, for Indiana's 9th Congressional District and will face Republican incumbent Erin Houchin in November.
Meyer was born in Brownsburg, Indiana, and earned bachelor's and master's degrees from Purdue University in Indianapolis.
He has worked in local manufacturing and as a civilian engineer for Crane Naval Sea Systems Command.

sources.title: Brad Meyer wins Democratic primary in 9th Congressional District
